title: Quality Assurance Coordinator (Ice Cream Plant) Bellevue, WA

cond_0001.intro: As the Quality Assurance Coordinator for our ice cream production facility you will be primarily responsible for supporting compliance with Corporate Quality Assurance standards – implementing quality and food safety programs, validating HACCP plans, maintaining plant operations adherence to good manufacturing procedures, standard operating procedures pertaining to quality and sanitation standard operating procedures. Your role will involve collaborating with production teams to identify and address quality issues, conducting audits, and continuously improving processes to enhance product quality and safety.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Develop, implement, and roll out new quality programs (sanitary maintenance, BRC audit gap analysis) to meet corporate quality standards and the plant goals of improving quality and reducing customer complaints.
Actively participate in regulatory audits and perform Acting QA Supervisor duties during QA Supervisor absence.
Perform plant floor duties including but not limited to quality audit inspection record keeping, product sample collection and analysis, HACCP updating, compliance, auditing, and active participation in the 5S program.
Collecting quality related information from plant floor operators and ensuring compliance with quality standard operating procedures.
HACCP or other regulatory quality system(s) compliance.
Data collection, procedure development and record keeping.
Dealing with regulatory and plant personnel ensuring ongoing compliance.
Microbiological analysis. Preparation and plating of samples. Ability to read and understand microbiological issues and test results.
Also, may include the purchasing of lab supplies, laboratory equipment and labels.
Communicate results to management ensuring production staff understand ongoing quality assurance issues and production results. Would include posting of production information and discussion of quality related root cause analysis and solutions.
Participate in regulatory audits and perform acting QA Manager duties during the QA Manager's absence.
Working knowledge of Global Food Safety Initiatives and FSMA (Food Safety Modernization Act).
Work flexible hours and participate in operational tasks outside of the quality role as needed to assess and improve food safety and quality program.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in food science, Chemistry, Microbiology, or related field.
3 To 5 years experience in Quality Assurance and laboratory experience.
HACCP/FSMA certified or willing to become certified within 6 months of hire.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Strong analytical and technical writing skills.
Ability to work independently and with a team.
Demonstrated time management and prioritization skills.
Excellent analytical judgment with confidence to act.
Preferred Requirements
Excellent PC skills including proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint; ability to grasp additional business-related applications.
High degree of initiative and sense of urgency.
Establish and maintain effective communication with internal and external customers.
Energetic, self-motivated and the ability to manage multiple projects across multi-functional teams.
Ability to motivate, lead and influence various levels of the organization.
5% Travel required.
cond_0001.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

cond_0029.intro: As the Quality Assurance Coordinator for our ice cream production facility you will be primarily responsible for supporting compliance with Corporate Quality Assurance standards – implementing quality and food safety programs, validating HACCP plans, maintaining plant operations adherence to good manufacturing procedures, standard operating procedures pertaining to quality and sanitation standard operating procedures. Your role will involve collaborating with production teams to identify and address quality issues, conducting audits, and continuously improving processes to enhance product quality and safety.
cond_0029.responsibilities:
Develop, implement, and roll out new quality programs (sanitary maintenance, BRC audit gap analysis) to meet corporate quality standards and the plant goals of improving quality and reducing customer complaints.
Actively participate in regulatory audits and perform Acting QA Supervisor duties during QA Supervisor absence.
Perform plant floor duties including but not limited to quality audit inspection record keeping, product sample collection and analysis, HACCP updating, compliance, auditing, and active participation in the 5S program.
Collecting quality related information from plant floor operators and ensuring compliance with quality standard operating procedures.
HACCP or other regulatory quality system(s) compliance.
Data collection, procedure development and record keeping.
Dealing with regulatory and plant personnel ensuring ongoing compliance.
Microbiological analysis. Preparation and plating of samples. Ability to read and understand microbiological issues and test results. Also, may include the purchasing of lab supplies, laboratory equipment and labels.
Communicate results to management ensuring production staff understand ongoing quality assurance issues and production results. Would include posting of production information and discussion of quality related root cause analysis and solutions.
Participate in regulatory audits and perform acting QA Manager duties during the QA Manager's absence.
Working knowledge of Global Food Safety Initiatives and FSMA (Food Safety Modernization Act).
Work flexible hours and participate in operational tasks outside of the quality role as needed to assess and improve food safety and quality program.
cond_0029.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in food science, Chemistry, Microbiology, or related field required; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Minimum 5 years of demonstrated expertise in Quality Assurance and laboratory environments.
Deep knowledge of PC applications including strong command of Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint; proven ability to adopt additional business-related applications.
HACCP/FSMA certified, or able to obtain certification within 6 months of hire.
Proven ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Substantial initiative and a consistent sense of urgency.
Exceptional analytical judgment with the confidence to act decisively.
Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, including strong analytical and technical writing ability.
Demonstrated ability to establish and maintain effective communication with internal and external customers.
Extensive time management and prioritization skills required.
Self-directed and able to manage multiple projects across multi-functional teams simultaneously.
Strong leadership ability and demonstrated capacity to influence various levels of the organization.
5% Travel required.

cond_0117.intro: As the Quality Assurance Coordinator for our ice cream production facility, you will work alongside production teams to support compliance with Corporate Quality Assurance standards — helping implement quality and food safety programs, validating HACCP plans, and maintaining plant operations in line with good manufacturing procedures, standard operating procedures for quality and sanitation. You will coordinate with production teams to identify and address quality issues, assist with audits, and work together on continuous process improvements to enhance product quality and safety.
cond_0117.responsibilities:
Coordinate with teams to develop, implement, and roll out new quality programs (sanitary maintenance, BRC audit gap analysis) to meet corporate quality standards and plant goals of improving quality and reducing customer complaints.
Assist in regulatory audits and support Acting QA Supervisor duties during QA Supervisor absence.
Work alongside plant floor staff on quality audit inspection record keeping, product sample collection and analysis, HACCP updating, compliance, auditing, and participation in the 5S program.
Gather quality-related information from plant floor operators and help ensure compliance with quality standard operating procedures.
Support HACCP and other regulatory quality system(s) compliance.
Assist with data collection, procedure development, and record keeping.
Work with regulatory and plant personnel to help maintain ongoing compliance.
Conduct microbiological analysis, including preparation and plating of samples.
Help interpret microbiological issues and test results, and assist with purchasing lab supplies, laboratory equipment, and labels as needed.
Share results with management and help production staff understand ongoing quality assurance issues and production outcomes, including posting production information and contributing to quality-related root cause analysis and solutions.
Assist in regulatory audits and support Acting QA Manager duties during the QA Manager's absence.
Apply working knowledge of Global Food Safety Initiatives and FSMA (Food Safety Modernization Act) in day-to-day work.
Work flexible hours and assist with operational tasks outside the quality role as needed to support food safety and quality program improvements.
cond_0117.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in food science, Chemistry, Microbiology, or related field.
3 To 5 years of experience in Quality Assurance and laboratory work.
HACCP/FSMA certified or willing to become certified within 6 months of hire.
Working knowledge of Global Food Safety Initiatives and FSMA.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including strong analytical and technical writing.
Ability to work both independently and as part of a team.
Strong analytical judgment with the confidence to act on findings.
Demonstrated time management and prioritization skills.
Preferred Requirements
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint; ability to learn additional business applications.
Ability to establish and maintain effective communication with internal and external contacts.
Ability to motivate and influence staff at various levels of the organization.
Experience managing multiple projects across cross-functional teams.
High degree of initiative and sense of urgency.
5% Travel.

We are looking for someone to join our team in this role.
As the Quality Assurance Coordinator for our ice cream production facility you will be primarily responsible for supporting compliance with Corporate Quality Assurance standards – implementing quality and food safety programs, validating HACCP plans, maintaining plant operations adherence to good manufacturing procedures, standard operating procedures pertaining to quality and sanitation standard operating procedures. Your role will involve collaborating with production teams to identify and address quality issues, conducting audits, and continuously improving processes to enhance product quality and safety. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp food safety systems and the logic behind quality compliance work.
cond_0220.responsibilities: Develop, implement, and roll out new quality programs (sanitary maintenance, BRC audit gap analysis) to meet corporate quality standards and the plant goals of improving quality and reducing customer complaints. Actively participate in regulatory audits and perform Acting QA Supervisor duties during QA Supervisor absence. Perform plant floor duties including but not limited to quality audit inspection record keeping, product sample collection and analysis, HACCP updating, compliance, auditing, and active participation in the 5S program. Collecting quality related information from plant floor operators and ensuring compliance with quality standard operating procedures. HACCP or other regulatory quality system(s) compliance. Data collection, procedure development and record keeping. Dealing with regulatory and plant personnel ensuring ongoing compliance. Microbiological analysis. Preparation and plating of samples. Ability to read and understand microbiological issues and test results. Also, may include the purchasing of lab supplies, laboratory equipment and labels. Communicate results to management ensuring production staff understand ongoing quality assurance issues and production results. Would include posting of production information and discussion of quality related root cause analysis and solutions. Participate in regulatory audits and perform acting QA Manager duties during the QA Manager's absence. Working knowledge of Global Food Safety Initiatives and FSMA (Food Safety Modernization Act). Work flexible hours and participate in operational tasks outside of the quality role as needed to assess and improve food safety and quality program.

Bachelor's degree in food science, Chemistry, Microbiology, or related field.
3 To 5 years experience in Quality Assurance and laboratory experience.
HACCP/FSMA certified or willing to become certified within 6 months of hire.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Strong analytical and technical writing skills.
Ability to work independently and with a team.
Demonstrated time management and prioritization skills.
Establish and maintain effective communication with internal and external customers.

Excellent PC skills including proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint; ability to grasp additional business-related applications.
High degree of initiative and sense of urgency.

cond_0248.intro: We are looking for someone to join our team as a Quality Assurance Coordinator for our ice cream production facility. Your role will involve collaborating with production teams to identify and address quality issues, conducting audits, and continuously improving processes to enhance product quality and safety. People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with food safety and quality systems.
cond_0248.responsibilities:
Develop, implement, and roll out new quality programs (sanitary maintenance, BRC audit gap analysis) to meet corporate quality standards and the plant goals of improving quality and reducing customer complaints.
Actively participate in regulatory audits and perform Acting QA Supervisor duties during QA Supervisor absence.
Perform plant floor duties including but not limited to quality audit inspection record keeping, product sample collection and analysis, HACCP updating, compliance, auditing, and active participation in the 5S program.
Collecting quality related information from plant floor operators and ensuring compliance with quality standard operating procedures.
HACCP or other regulatory quality system(s) compliance.
Data collection, procedure development and record keeping.
Dealing with regulatory and plant personnel ensuring ongoing compliance.
Microbiological analysis.
Preparation and plating of samples.
Ability to read and understand microbiological issues and test results.
Also, may include the purchasing of lab supplies, laboratory equipment and labels.
Communicate results to management ensuring production staff understand ongoing quality assurance issues and production results.
Would include posting of production information and discussion of quality related root cause analysis and solutions.
Participate in regulatory audits and perform acting QA Manager duties during the QA Manager's absence.
Working knowledge of Global Food Safety Initiatives and FSMA (Food Safety Modernization Act).
Work flexible hours and participate in operational tasks outside of the quality role as needed to assess and improve food safety and quality program.

cond_0286.intro: We are looking for a Quality Assurance Coordinator for our ice cream production facility. This role is primarily responsible for supporting compliance with Corporate Quality Assurance standards — implementing quality and food safety programs, validating HACCP plans, maintaining plant operations adherence to good manufacturing procedures, standard operating procedures pertaining to quality and sanitation standard operating procedures. The role involves coordinating with production teams to identify and address quality issues, conducting audits, and improving processes to support product quality and safety.
cond_0286.responsibilities:
Develop, implement, and roll out new quality programs (sanitary maintenance, BRC audit gap analysis) to meet corporate quality standards and plant goals of improving quality and reducing customer complaints.
Step in for Acting QA Supervisor duties during QA Supervisor absence and participate in regulatory audits as required.
Perform plant floor duties including quality audit inspection record keeping, product sample collection and analysis, HACCP updating, compliance, auditing, and participation in the 5S program.
Gather quality-related information from plant floor operators and verify compliance with quality standard operating procedures.
Maintain HACCP or other regulatory quality system(s) compliance.
Handle data collection, procedure development, and record keeping.
Coordinate with regulatory and plant personnel to maintain ongoing compliance.
Conduct microbiological analysis including preparation and plating of samples.
Read and interpret microbiological issues and test results.
Manage purchasing of lab supplies, laboratory equipment, and labels as needed.
Document results and share with management so production staff are informed of ongoing quality assurance issues and production outcomes. This includes posting production information and supporting root cause analysis and solutions.
Step in for Acting QA Manager duties during the QA Manager's absence and participate in regulatory audits as required.
Apply working knowledge of Global Food Safety Initiatives and FSMA (Food Safety Modernization Act).
Work flexible hours and carry out operational tasks outside the quality role as needed to assess and support food safety and quality programs.
cond_0286.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in food science, Chemistry, Microbiology, or related field.
3 To 5 years of experience in Quality Assurance and laboratory work.
Strong PC skills including proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint; ability to learn additional business-related applications.
HACCP/FSMA certified or willing to become certified within 6 months of hire.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
High degree of initiative and sense of urgency.
Strong analytical judgment with the confidence to act on findings.
Strong written communication and clear, direct verbal reporting. Strong analytical and technical writing skills.
Ability to maintain effective communication with internal and external contacts.
Demonstrated time management and prioritization skills.
Self-motivated with the ability to manage multiple projects across multi-functional teams.
Ability to influence and guide various levels of the organization.
5% Travel required.
cond_0286.values: We value delivering results to a high standard and taking pride in work done well. We aim to be defined by quality, consistency, and strong performance.

cond_0296.intro: We are looking for a Quality Assurance Coordinator to join our ice cream production facility. In this role, you will own compliance with Corporate Quality Assurance standards — leading the implementation of quality and food safety programs, validating HACCP plans, and ensuring plant operations adhere to good manufacturing procedures, quality SOPs, and sanitation SOPs. You will take charge of identifying and resolving quality issues with production teams, conducting audits, and driving continuous process improvements to strengthen product quality and safety.
cond_0296.responsibilities:
Lead the development, implementation, and rollout of new quality programs (sanitary maintenance, BRC audit gap analysis) to meet corporate quality standards and plant goals of improving quality and reducing customer complaints.
Take an active role in regulatory audits and execute Acting QA Supervisor duties during QA Supervisor absence.
Own plant floor duties including quality audit inspection record keeping, product sample collection and analysis, HACCP updating, compliance, auditing, and active participation in the 5S program.
Gather quality-related information from plant floor operators and ensure compliance with quality standard operating procedures.
Maintain HACCP and other regulatory quality system(s) compliance.
Execute data collection, procedure development, and record keeping.
Manage relationships with regulatory and plant personnel to ensure ongoing compliance.
Conduct microbiological analysis, including preparation and plating of samples.
Interpret microbiological issues and test results, and oversee purchasing of lab supplies, laboratory equipment, and labels as needed.
Communicate results to management and ensure production staff understand ongoing quality assurance issues and production outcomes, including posting production information and leading root cause analysis discussions.
Step into Acting QA Manager duties during the QA Manager's absence.
Apply working knowledge of Global Food Safety Initiatives and FSMA (Food Safety Modernization Act).
Work flexible hours and take on operational tasks outside the quality role as needed to assess and improve food safety and quality programs.
cond_0296.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in food science, Chemistry, Microbiology, or related field.
3 To 5 years of experience in Quality Assurance and laboratory work.
HACCP/FSMA certified or willing to become certified within 6 months of hire.
Working knowledge of HACCP, FSMA, and Global Food Safety Initiatives.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including strong technical writing.
Ability to work independently and with a team.
Demonstrated time management and prioritization skills.
5% Travel.
Preferred Requirements
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint; ability to learn additional business applications.
High degree of initiative and sense of urgency.
Excellent analytical judgment with confidence to act.
Ability to establish and maintain effective communication with internal and external customers.
Ability to manage multiple projects across multi-functional teams.
Ability to motivate, lead, and influence various levels of the organization.

cond_0306.intro: We are looking for a Quality Assurance Coordinator to join our ice cream production facility team. In this role, you will work alongside production and quality teams to support compliance with Corporate Quality Assurance standards — helping implement quality and food safety programs, validate HACCP plans, and maintain adherence to good manufacturing procedures, standard operating procedures, and sanitation standards. You will coordinate with production teams to identify and address quality issues, assist with audits, and contribute to ongoing process improvements that support product quality and safety.
cond_0306.responsibilities:
Coordinate with the team to develop, implement, and roll out new quality programs (sanitary maintenance, BRC audit gap analysis) to meet corporate quality standards and plant goals of improving quality and reducing customer complaints.
Actively participate in regulatory audits and assist by performing Acting QA Supervisor duties during QA Supervisor absence.
Support plant floor operations including quality audit inspection record keeping, product sample collection and analysis, HACCP updating, compliance, auditing, and active participation in the 5S program.
Work with plant floor operators to gather quality-related information and help ensure compliance with quality standard operating procedures.
Support HACCP and other regulatory quality system(s) compliance.
Assist with data collection, procedure development, and record keeping.
Coordinate with regulatory and plant personnel to help maintain ongoing compliance.
Conduct microbiological analysis, including preparation and plating of samples.
Help interpret microbiological issues and test results, and share findings with relevant team members.
Assist with purchasing of lab supplies, laboratory equipment, and labels as needed.
Share results with management and help ensure production staff understand ongoing quality assurance issues and production outcomes, including posting production information and contributing to quality-related root cause analysis and solutions.
Participate in regulatory audits and assist by performing Acting QA Manager duties during the QA Manager's absence.
Apply working knowledge of Global Food Safety Initiatives and FSMA (Food Safety Modernization Act) in day-to-day work.
Work flexible hours and participate in operational tasks outside of the quality role as needed to support food safety and quality program assessment and improvement.

cond_0327.intro: As the Quality Assurance Coordinator for our ice cream production facility you will be primarily responsible for supporting compliance with Corporate Quality Assurance standards – implementing quality and food safety programs, validating HACCP plans, maintaining plant operations adherence to good manufacturing procedures, standard operating procedures pertaining to quality and sanitation standard operating procedures. Your role will involve collaborating with production teams to identify and address quality issues, conducting audits, and continuously improving processes to enhance product quality and safety.
cond_0327.responsibilities:
Develop, implement, and roll out new quality programs (sanitary maintenance, BRC audit gap analysis) to meet corporate quality standards and the plant goals of improving quality and reducing customer complaints.
Actively participate in regulatory audits and perform Acting QA Supervisor duties during QA Supervisor absence.
Perform plant floor duties including but not limited to quality audit inspection record keeping, product sample collection and analysis, HACCP updating, compliance, auditing, and active participation in the 5S program.
Collecting quality related information from plant floor operators and ensuring compliance with quality standard operating procedures.
HACCP or other regulatory quality system(s) compliance.
Data collection, procedure development and record keeping.
Dealing with regulatory and plant personnel ensuring ongoing compliance.
Microbiological analysis. Preparation and plating of samples. Ability to read and understand microbiological issues and test results.
Also, may include the purchasing of lab supplies, laboratory equipment and labels.
Communicate results to management ensuring production staff understand ongoing quality assurance issues and production results. Would include posting of production information and discussion of quality related root cause analysis and solutions.
Participate in regulatory audits and perform acting QA Manager duties during the QA Manager's absence.
Working knowledge of Global Food Safety Initiatives and FSMA (Food Safety Modernization Act).
Work flexible hours and participate in operational tasks outside of the quality role as needed to assess and improve food safety and quality program.
cond_0327.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in food science, Chemistry, Microbiology, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Around 3 to 5 years of experience in Quality Assurance and laboratory work.
Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint; openness to learning additional business-related applications.
HACCP/FSMA certified, or willingness to become certified within 6 months of hire.
Ability to work both independently and as part of a team.
Ability to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing, including technical writing.
5% Travel.
Preferred Requirements
Familiarity with Global Food Safety Initiatives and FSMA.
Experience managing multiple projects across cross-functional teams.
Ability to build and maintain effective communication with internal and external contacts.
Background in motivating or influencing people at various levels of an organization.
Comfort with prioritizing and managing time across competing tasks.
A proactive approach and willingness to take initiative.

cond_0387.intro: As the Quality Assurance Coordinator for our ice cream production facility, you will work alongside production teams to support compliance with Corporate Quality Assurance standards — helping implement quality and food safety programs, validating HACCP plans, and maintaining plant operations in line with good manufacturing procedures, standard operating procedures for quality and sanitation. You will coordinate with production teams to identify and address quality issues, assist with audits, and work together on continuous process improvements to enhance product quality and safety.
cond_0387.responsibilities:
Coordinate with teams to develop, implement, and roll out new quality programs (sanitary maintenance, BRC audit gap analysis) to meet corporate quality standards and plant goals of improving quality and reducing customer complaints.
Assist in regulatory audits and support Acting QA Supervisor duties during QA Supervisor absence.
Work alongside plant floor staff on quality audit inspection record keeping, product sample collection and analysis, HACCP updating, compliance, auditing, and participation in the 5S program.
Gather quality-related information from plant floor operators and help ensure compliance with quality standard operating procedures.
Support HACCP and other regulatory quality system(s) compliance.
Assist with data collection, procedure development, and record keeping.
Work with regulatory and plant personnel to help maintain ongoing compliance.
Conduct microbiological analysis, including preparation and plating of samples.
Help interpret microbiological issues and test results, and assist with purchasing lab supplies, laboratory equipment, and labels as needed.
Share results with management and help production staff understand ongoing quality assurance issues and production outcomes, including posting production information and contributing to quality-related root cause analysis and solutions.
Assist in regulatory audits and support Acting QA Manager duties during the QA Manager's absence.
Apply working knowledge of Global Food Safety Initiatives and FSMA (Food Safety Modernization Act) in day-to-day work.
Work flexible hours and assist with operational tasks outside the quality role as needed to support food safety and quality program improvements.
cond_0387.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in food science, Chemistry, Microbiology, or related field.
3 To 5 years of experience in Quality Assurance and laboratory work.
HACCP/FSMA certified or willing to become certified within 6 months of hire.
Working knowledge of Global Food Safety Initiatives and FSMA.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including strong analytical and technical writing.
Ability to work both independently and as part of a team.
Strong analytical judgment with the confidence to act on findings.
Demonstrated time management and prioritization skills.
Preferred Requirements
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint; ability to learn additional business applications.
Ability to establish and maintain effective communication with internal and external contacts.
Ability to motivate and influence staff at various levels of the organization.
Experience managing multiple projects across cross-functional teams.
High degree of initiative and sense of urgency.
5% Travel.

cond_0480.intro: As the Quality Assurance Coordinator for our ice cream production facility you will be primarily responsible for supporting compliance with Corporate Quality Assurance standards – implementing quality and food safety programs, validating HACCP plans, maintaining plant operations adherence to good manufacturing procedures, standard operating procedures pertaining to quality and sanitation standard operating procedures. Your role will involve collaborating with production teams to identify and address quality issues, conducting audits, and continuously improving processes to enhance product quality and safety.
cond_0480.responsibilities:
Develop, implement, and roll out new quality programs (sanitary maintenance, BRC audit gap analysis) to meet corporate quality standards and the plant goals of improving quality and reducing customer complaints.
Actively participate in regulatory audits and perform Acting QA Supervisor duties during QA Supervisor absence.
Perform plant floor duties including but not limited to quality audit inspection record keeping, product sample collection and analysis, HACCP updating, compliance, auditing, and active participation in the 5S program.
Collecting quality related information from plant floor operators and ensuring compliance with quality standard operating procedures.
HACCP or other regulatory quality system(s) compliance.
Data collection, procedure development and record keeping.
Dealing with regulatory and plant personnel ensuring ongoing compliance.
Microbiological analysis.
Preparation and plating of samples.
Ability to read and understand microbiological issues and test results.
Also, may include the purchasing of lab supplies, laboratory equipment and labels.
Communicate results to management ensuring production staff understand ongoing quality assurance issues and production results.
Would include posting of production information and discussion of quality related root cause analysis and solutions.
Participate in regulatory audits and perform acting QA Manager duties during the QA Manager's absence.
Working knowledge of Global Food Safety Initiatives and FSMA (Food Safety Modernization Act).
Work flexible hours and participate in operational tasks outside of the quality role as needed to assess and improve food safety and quality program.
cond_0480.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in food science, Chemistry, Microbiology, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Around 3 to 5 years of experience in Quality Assurance and laboratory work, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint; willingness to learn additional business-related applications.
HACCP/FSMA certified, or willingness to become certified within 6 months of hire.
Ability to work independently and with a team.
Willingness to take initiative and follow through on tasks.
Solid analytical judgment and the ability to act on findings.
Clear verbal and written communication skills, including technical writing.
Ability to build and maintain effective communication with internal and external contacts.
Familiarity with time management and prioritization in a multi-task environment.
Comfort managing multiple projects across different teams.
Ability to work with and influence people at various levels of the organization.
5% Travel required.

cond_0500.intro: We are looking for someone to join our team as a Quality Assurance Coordinator for our ice cream production facility. You will be primarily responsible for supporting compliance with Corporate Quality Assurance standards – implementing quality and food safety programs, validating HACCP plans, maintaining plant operations adherence to good manufacturing procedures, standard operating procedures pertaining to quality and sanitation standard operating procedures. Your role will involve collaborating with production teams to identify and address quality issues, conducting audits, and continuously improving processes to enhance product quality and safety. People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with food safety and quality systems.
cond_0500.responsibilities:
Develop, implement, and roll out new quality programs (sanitary maintenance, BRC audit gap analysis) to meet corporate quality standards and the plant goals of improving quality and reducing customer complaints.
Actively participate in regulatory audits and perform Acting QA Supervisor duties during QA Supervisor absence.
Perform plant floor duties including but not limited to quality audit inspection record keeping, product sample collection and analysis, HACCP updating, compliance, auditing, and active participation in the 5S program.
Collecting quality related information from plant floor operators and ensuring compliance with quality standard operating procedures.
HACCP or other regulatory quality system(s) compliance.
Data collection, procedure development and record keeping.
Dealing with regulatory and plant personnel ensuring ongoing compliance.
Microbiological analysis.
Preparation and plating of samples.
Ability to read and understand microbiological issues and test results.
Also, may include the purchasing of lab supplies, laboratory equipment and labels.
Communicate results to management ensuring production staff understand ongoing quality assurance issues and production results.
Would include posting of production information and discussion of quality related root cause analysis and solutions.
Participate in regulatory audits and perform acting QA Manager duties during the QA Manager's absence.
Working knowledge of Global Food Safety Initiatives and FSMA (Food Safety Modernization Act).
Work flexible hours and participate in operational tasks outside of the quality role as needed to assess and improve food safety and quality program.
cond_0500.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in food science, Chemistry, Microbiology, or related field.
3 To 5 years experience in Quality Assurance and laboratory experience.
Excellent PC skills including proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint; ability to grasp additional business-related applications.
HACCP/FSMA certified or is willing to become certified within 6 months of hire.
Ability to work independently and with a team.
High degree of initiative and sense of urgency.
Excellent analytical judgment with confidence to act.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Strong analytical and technical writing skills.
Establish and maintain effective communication with internal and external customers.
Demonstrated time management and prioritization skills required.
Energetic, self-motivated and the ability to manage multiple projects across multi-functional teams.
Ability to motivate, lead and influence various levels of the organization.
5% Travel required.
